Package org.tweetyproject.web.services.paf

Class PafReasonerPost

java.lang.Object
org.tweetyproject.web.services.paf.PafReasonerPost
public class PafReasonerPost extends Object
Request payload for the probabilistic argumentation framework (PAF) reasoner endpoint.

Arguments are numbered 1..nr_of_arguments. argument_probabilities[i] is the existence probability of argument i+1. attack_probabilities[j] is the existence probability of attacks[j].
